candidates.change_summary: Remove the IERC1155 interfaceId check so supportsInterface no longer reports the core ERC1155 interface.
Remove the IERC1155MetadataURI interfaceId check so supportsInterface no longer reports the metadata interface.
Remove the super.supportsInterface call so supportsInterface no longer reports the ERC165 interface.
Swap the mapping key order so the balance lookup uses the token id keyed by account instead of account keyed by token id.
Return the balance of msg.sender instead of the passed account parameter.
Remove the require that rejects the zero address, so balanceOf(zeroAddress, id) returns 0 instead of reverting.
Return the caller's balance instead of the queried account's balance.
Swap the mapping key order, indexing by account then id, so a different balance slot is returned.
